articles.title: DRDO successfully flight-tests Pinaka guided rockets with enhanced 60 km range
articles.summary: DRDO successfully conducted a flight-test of the Pinaka Long Range Guided Rocket (LRGR), a significant step towards bolstering India's firepower capabilities. This development enhances the nation's indigenous missile technology and strengthens its strategic arsenal. The successful test reinforces national security through advanced weaponry, showcasing ongoing defence research and development efforts.

articles.title: JS Takanami conducts PASSEX with INS Surat off Mumbai coast
articles.summary: The Japan Maritime Self Defence Force (JMSDF) warship JS Takanami (DD-110) conducted joint naval activities with an Indian Navy warship near Mumbai. This collaboration highlights growing defence cooperation and maritime partnership between India and Japan. For SSB aspirants, such exercises are crucial for understanding international naval interoperability and strategic alliances in safeguarding maritime interests.

articles.title: India planning upgrade of Russian-made armor – media
articles.summary: India is reportedly planning a significant $7.85 billion upgrade for its Russian-made tanks and armored vehicles, according to army sources. This ambitious modernization drive aims to enhance the operational capabilities and extend the life-cycle of crucial ground force assets. Such investment underscores India's commitment to bolstering its defence preparedness and ensuring its military remains combat-ready against evolving security challenges.

articles.title: ISRO successfully tests Gaganyaan crew module's main parachute
articles.summary: ISRO successfully conducted a critical test on the main parachutes for India's Gaganyaan crew module. This crucial milestone, performed at the Aerial Delivery Research and Development Establishment (ADRDE) in Agra, demonstrated the parachute system's capability for a safe landing. The test validates key technology for the human spaceflight mission, ensuring the crew's secure return to Earth, marking a significant step for India's ambitious space program.

articles.title: Denmark Confirms Plan to Purchase P-8 Poseidon Maritime Patrol Aircraft
articles.summary: Denmark's Ministry of Defence provisionally decided to acquire two P-8A maritime patrol aircraft, following a Chief of Defence recommendation. This strategic move significantly bolsters Denmark's defence capabilities, particularly for anti-submarine warfare and reconnaissance. The P-8A acquisition enhances national maritime security and interoperability, reflecting Denmark's commitment to modernising its armed forces.

articles.title: RDO conducts successful flight-test of Pinaka Long Range Guided Rocket
articles.summary: The Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully conducted a flight-test of the Pinaka multi-barrel rocket launcher system on July 8, 2026. This achievement, under the Ministry of Defence, signifies India's continuous advancement in indigenous defence capabilities. Such tests are crucial for validating system upgrades, enhancing accuracy and range, and strengthening national security and self-reliance in critical weaponry.
